title: In Vivo Interactions of Nucleic Acid Nanostructures With Cells.

sections.heading: Introduction
Classical Nanomedicine Applications of Nucleic Acid Nanostructures

operations.sentence: To start with, electrostatic repulsion between polyanionic nucleic acid nanostructures and cell membranes (also negatively charged) does not necessarily prohibit cellular entry.

Despite the plethora of biomedical applications of nucleic acid nanostructures, our basic knowledge of their cell‐NP interaction remains weak and the published experimental data often fail to address if a given nucleic acid nanostructure reached the desired cell type after injection into the body.
